explication: ReMe is a local-first, file-native knowledge base for AI agents: users and agents write Markdown memories, ReMe indexes them, then retrieves relevant passages and linked context. The central runtime configures components and exposes workflow jobs through HTTP/MCP or other interfaces. Separate workflows evolve conversations and resources into durable notes, and proactively consolidate knowledge. Studio provides a workspace for interacting with those files. The README documents these capabilities; sampled source confirms application wiring, component lookup, and HTTP job routing, but several domain-stage connections are documented rather than source-verified.
